page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n4.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with a shared CPU allocation model and 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of memory, yielding 2.0 GB per core, and operates on a KVM hypervisor. It does not include bundled local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a mixed profile. Single-core performance is generally limited, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the weak and poor categories respectively. However, multi-core performance scales to average levels in stress-ng and Passmark CPU testing. Memory bandwidth remains stable, registering average read-only speeds of 603.07 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 60.46 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Software compilation with clang, ray tracing, and image processing benchmarks also achieve average tier results, while text processing and compression tasks show poor performance.

Given its shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage, this instance offers a budget-oriented hardware profile. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can tolerate shared resource contention and do not require high single-threaded performance. Suitable workloads include static web serving, where it achieves an average throughput of 7.92 GB/sec, Redis key-value operations, and basic multi-threaded utility tasks. It is less suitable for memory-intensive databases or large language model inference.
